name: autofire
description: Read inventory, sales leads, test-drive requests, LotIQ follow-up priorities, and daily insights from your independent used car dealership's AutoFire account.

interface.longDescription:
Built for independent used car dealerships, AutoFire brings your inventory, sales leads, and daily priorities into ChatGPT and Codex. Owners, managers, and sales teams can ask questions about their dealership's AutoFire data in plain language.

Find vehicles for a buyer: check available inventory, compare prices and mileage, and look up a vehicle's trim, features, and photos.

Prioritize lead follow-up: review new inquiries and lead status, then use LotIQ follow-up priorities to see which leads need attention and why.

Prepare for test drives: review test-drive requests and their status. Get a dealership briefing by combining inventory, follow-up priorities, test drives, and the latest saved insights reports.

Requires an AutoFire account with access to a dealership. Connect your account, choose the dealership and permissions, then try one of the prompts above. The plugin reads the connected dealership's data only. It does not change inventory or prices, contact customers, or book appointments.

You control access. Customer names and contact details require the separate Lead contact details permission. Disconnect at any time from your AutoFire dashboard.
defaultPrompt: Show our available vehicles under $25,000 with year, make, model, mileage, and price.
Which leads are due for follow-up today? Show their priority and explain why.
Give me a morning briefing: inventory, lead follow-up priorities, test-drive requests, and latest dealership insights.

positive.prompt: Which dealership is AutoFire connected to, and what are its hours?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the connected dealership's name, city, state, and hours.

positive.prompt: List five available vehicles under $30,000 with year, make, model, mileage, and price.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns up to five matching available vehicles from the connected dealership only.

positive.prompt: Give me the full details and features for the first one.
positive.expected_behavior: After the inventory search, returns trim, engine, colors, features, and photos for that vehicle.

positive.prompt: Which leads are due for follow-up, and why?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns lead ids with priority and reason; no names or contact details unless the Lead contact details permission was granted.
Summarizes the most recent insights report(s) for the connected dealership.

negative.description: Market-wide car shopping is outside the dealership's own data; the plugin should not act.
negative.prompt: Find me a used Honda Civic under $20,000 for sale near Austin, Texas.

negative.description: Vehicle valuation is not something AutoFire provides; the plugin should not act.
negative.prompt: What's a 2018 Toyota Camry with 60,000 miles worth as a trade-in?

negative.description: General maintenance questions are unrelated to dealership data; the plugin should not act.
negative.prompt: How often should I change the oil in my 2015 Ford F-150?

review.commerce_description: AutoFire reads dealership data only; it does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: 1.0.4: Refocused the listing on independent used car dealerships. Updated the subtitle, description, discovery keywords, and starter prompts for inventory searches, lead follow-up, and a daily dealership briefing. Replaced the legacy flame logo and composer icon with the current AutoFire A brand mark used by the website. Clarified account requirements and read-only access. No changes to MCP tools, permissions, or authentication.
